get_user_memories: get all memories stored for the authenticated user from the vector database
add_memory_with_embedding: add a new memory entry and store its vector embedding in the user's vector collection
query_memories_similar: query memories by semantic similarity and return the top k matching results
reset_memory_vector_store: reset the user's vector memory store by deleting and re-indexing all existing memories
delete_memory_by_id: delete a specific memory entry and remove it from the user's vector collection
